AlphaTheta Music Americas

  • Torrance, CA, USA
  • https://alphatheta.com/en/
  • Company Description
  • Jobs (0)

AlphaTheta Corporation is a global leader in DJ, audio, and music production technology, dedicated to driving innovation and fostering creative expression. Our mission, "One Through Music," reflects our belief in the unifying power of music and guides our efforts to deliver high-quality, inspiring tools to creators worldwide. Our portfolio includes trusted brands such as Pioneer DJ, AlphaTheta, rekordbox, KUVO, TORAIZ, and Pioneer PRO AUDIO.

Originally established in 1994 as part of Pioneer Corporation, we introduced the groundbreaking CDJ-500—transforming the DJ industry. In 2015, we became an independent entity known as Pioneer DJ Corporation and rebranded as AlphaTheta in 2020 to align with our broader vision. Headquartered in Yokohama, Japan, we operate globally with offices across the Americas, EMEA, China, and Singapore, and are a proud subsidiary of Noritsu Koki Co., Ltd., listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
